title: Attractions
description: Explore some of Columbus’ top attractions, including museums, entertainment spots, historic landmarks, and family-friendly destinations across the city.

places.name: Columbus Zoo and Aquarium
places.description: A nationally known zoo featuring animal exhibits, aquarium attractions, rides, live shows, and seasonal events for all ages.

places.name: COSI
places.description: An interactive science museum with hands-on exhibits, live demonstrations, space displays, and educational activities.

places.name: National Veterans Memorial and Museum
places.description: A modern museum honoring veterans through personal stories, historical exhibits, and immersive experiences.

places.name: Ohio History Center
places.description: A museum exploring Ohio’s history with exhibits, artifacts, and interactive displays covering the state’s past and culture.

places.name: LEGOLAND Discovery Center Columbus
places.description: An indoor LEGO attraction with rides, building zones, play areas, and interactive activities for kids and families.

places.name: Prototype: The Experimental Museum
places.description: An immersive museum featuring creative art, technology exhibits, interactive installations, and experimental media experiences.

title: Shopping
description: Explore some of the best shopping destinations in Columbus, from outdoor shopping centers to local boutiques and markets.

places.name: Easton Town Center
places.description: A popular outdoor shopping district with major retailers, restaurants, entertainment, and seasonal events on the east side of Columbus.

places.name: Polaris Fashion Place
places.description: A large shopping mall in north Columbus featuring fashion stores, dining options, entertainment, and well-known brands.

places.name: German Village Shops
places.description: A historic neighborhood filled with local boutiques, bookstores, coffee shops, restaurants, and brick-lined streets south of downtown.

places.name: Short North Arts District
places.description: A vibrant district just north of downtown known for local shops, art galleries, restaurants, nightlife, and colorful street murals.

title: Outdoors
description: Enjoy parks, trails, riverfront views, and outdoor activities throughout the Columbus area.

places.name: Scioto Mile
places.description: A scenic downtown riverfront with walking trails, fountains, parks, and skyline views along the Scioto River.

places.name: Franklin Park Conservatory
places.description: A botanical garden and conservatory featuring beautiful plant collections, seasonal exhibits, outdoor gardens, and art displays near downtown.

places.name: Pickleball Courts
places.description: Popular outdoor and indoor pickleball courts around Columbus offering a fun and active way to enjoy the city with friends and family.

places.name: Scioto Audubon Metro Park
places.description: A large metro park south of downtown featuring walking trails, climbing walls, river views, playgrounds, and open green space.

title: Music
description: Discover live music venues, concerts, festivals, and local entertainment throughout Columbus.

places.name: KEMBA Live!
places.description: A major live music venue near downtown hosting concerts, festivals, and outdoor performances year-round.

places.name: The Bluestone
places.description: A historic church turned music venue known for concerts, events, and unique live performances near downtown Columbus.

places.name: Newport Music Hall
places.description: One of the country’s longest-running rock clubs featuring live music, touring artists, and local bands near Ohio State.

places.name: A&R Music Bar
places.description: A popular live music venue in the Arena District featuring concerts, local artists, touring bands, and indoor performances.

title: Nightlife
description: Experience Columbus nightlife with rooftop bars, live entertainment, restaurants, and late-night spots across the city.

places.name: Short North Nightlife
places.description: A lively district filled with bars, restaurants, rooftop patios, music venues, and late-night entertainment.

places.name: Bridge Park
places.description: A modern entertainment district in Dublin with rooftop bars, restaurants, nightlife, and riverfront views.

places.name: Pins Mechanical Co.
places.description: A social nightlife spot featuring duckpin bowling, arcade games, drinks, and outdoor gathering spaces.

places.name: Arena District
places.description: A downtown entertainment area with sports venues, bars, restaurants, concerts, and nightlife activities.

title: Day Trip Fun
description: Take a short drive from Columbus to explore amusement parks, outdoor adventures, and unique attractions across Ohio.

places.name: Cedar Point
places.description: A famous amusement park on Lake Erie known for roller coasters, rides, entertainment, and waterfront views.

places.name: Hocking Hills
places.description: A scenic outdoor destination featuring hiking trails, waterfalls, caves, forests, and stunning natural landscapes.

places.name: Kings Island
places.description: A large theme park near Cincinnati with roller coasters, water attractions, family rides, and live entertainment.

places.name: Yellow Springs
places.description: A small artsy town known for local shops, hiking trails, restaurants, parks, and a relaxed atmosphere.
